scope: Clean game audio and lost packets rebuilt on the way, from the 1.0.0.8 test: a game-audio player of VROSTBridge's own on both clients (patch 0022), the host's game-audio capture read straight from Windows' loopback stream (patch 0023), parity for video and game audio (patch 0021), Baballonia at a quarter of the normal CPU weight on Bazzite, a second try for base stations (one at a time on Bazzite), and only the 3 newest client reports kept on the host. Every package carries version 1.0.0.9; the host driver is rebuilt with patches 0001 to 0023.
changes: patches/0021-transport-forward-error-correction.patch (new): alvr_sockets vrostbridge_fec.rs and the UDP stream socket: XOR parity per interleaved group on stream ID | 0x8000 (video parity paced with its frame), one lost shard per group rebuilt, counted; the host's stream options fec_video_group and fec_audio_group; the client core's counters

patches/0022-client-audio-playback.patch (new): alvr_audio vrostbridge_playback.rs (JitterPlayer): the device at the stream's rate when offered, else a windowed-sinc converter; a 40 ms device buffer; the buffer held at its target by a speed correction of at most 0.5 %; losses cross-faded; on underrun a fade and a longer target; VROST_AUDIO_OUTPUT and counters for the transport

patches/0023-host-game-audio-capture.patch (new): alvr_audio vrostbridge_loopback.rs (LoopbackCapture): WASAPI loopback read directly (silent packets as zeros, discontinuities counted, Pro Audio scheduling, a silent keep-alive render stream, surround folded by channel mask with a soft limit), cpal as the fallback; the 6-channel downmix mapping gains front left; the Win32_Security feature of the windows crate for CreateEventW
client/transport (lib.rs, bridge.h): vrost_audio_stats and the parity counters; client/platform/linux/main.cpp: net_fec_* and audio_* on TIMING (both clients)
host/stream_options.py: patch features parity and audio-capture; fec_video_group 10 and fec_audio_group 1 for a driver that has patch 0021
launcher/app.py, desktop.html, timeline.py: the Game audio line, Rebuilt on the way, game audio in status and reports, the timeline's repaired, audio_dropouts and audio_lost
launcher/reporting.py, app.py: the host keeps the 3 newest received client reports and prunes at start
launcher/baballonia.py: CPUWeight=25 on Baballonia's systemd user unit
launcher/base_stations.py: one station at a time (BaseStations.ps1 already was); both: a second try after 1 s
tests: tests/test_vrostbridge_1009.py and page checks; earlier tests made to accept later releases (patch count, version)
Version 1.0.0.9 on every package; documents, release notes and the two PDFs

All were corrected; the packages checked here carry the corrected documents.
